name: cx-sequence
task: Find the key, pick it up, open the locked door, go into the room, and then pick up the ball.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The existence clauses for key_found, has_matching_key, target_door_open, and target_room_entered are redundant because the precedence chain and existence of later events already imply them. Remove these four Existence clauses; keep only the necessary Existence(target_picked_up) and the precedence constraints.

CHANGES REQUIRED: The clause set does not include hard Existence clauses for the steps that the task explicitly commands. In addition to the existing Existence(target_picked_up), the task requires the agent to (1) find the key – Existence(key_found), (2) pick it up – Existence(has_matching_key), (3) open the locked door – Existence(target_door_open), and (4) enter the target room – Existence(target_room_entered). Adding these hard Existence clauses (together with the existing hard Precedence rules) will correctly capture the sequence "find the key, pick it up, open the locked door, go into the room, and then pick up the ball."

texts: The agent must eventually find the key.
The agent must eventually pick up the matching key.
The agent must eventually open the locked door.
The agent must eventually enter the target room.
The agent must eventually pick up the target ball.
The agent must find the key before picking it up.
The agent must pick up the matching key before opening the locked door.
The agent must open the locked door before entering the target room.
The agent must enter the target room before picking up the target ball.
